title: Retained artifact reference
description: A versioned evidence reference. Local files are checked by SHA-256; external contents are not authenticated by the offline validator.

reference.description: Repository-relative file path or HTTP(S) URL, matching an artifact reference in the record.

version.description: Exact retained revision, release, archive version or other description identifying the evidence examined.

sha256.description: Required digest of retained local file bytes; optional for an external URL. An external digest is a declaration, not an offline content check.
